==Simple English==
Simple English doesn't have much common with Wikipedia's Simple English, Ogden's Basic English or Simple Technical English. It tries to present gimste in simple wordage and thus more usable for beginners in Lojban.
==gimste==
*ToDo: mitre/bunda etc. places
*ToDo: carna, chirality places
*Currently, Simple English definitions in jbovlaste are being reused for La Bangu dictionary. The changes are removing "by standard" places for most (but not all) {{jvs|smuvelcki}} where they exist, strictly specifying what tersumti what sumti type can accept.
*Changing the order or places is not planned except when the corpus strongly suggests the opposite and/or leads to misusage. ('''traji3=traji4''', '''mabla''', '''zabna''' are examples approved in [[La Bangu]]).
Less than 25 "by standard" places and 4 "under conditions" places retained and shouldn't be removed but instead rephrased.
*gimste must clearly specify sumti interactions ala gua\spi (e.g. x3+1,2)
*gimste must clearly specify sumti types (and subtypes).

==brivla==
#basic brivla: fu'ivla, cimjvo, gismu, cmevla
#compound brivla: jvajvo.

cimjvo are moved into fu'ivla (thus they are not-decomposable). jvajvo are taught separately.
*CVV rafsi can act only as suffixes.
*CCV rafsi can go anywhere.
*CVC rafsi are deleted ('''retsku''' is no different from fu'ivla, but '''retskugau''' has the -gau suffix).

'''fu'ivla''' might get regularized suffixes (thus they would belong to compound brivla) specifying their semantic classes. Thus ideologically they are like rafsi-suffixes (idea by [[la selpa'i]])

==cmavyste==
